definitions.explanation: The last game or match in a tournament that determines the champion.

examples.japanese: {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}に{進|すす}んだ。
{決勝戦|けっしょうせん}は{来週|らいしゅう}だ。
examples.english: The championship game is next week.

examples.japanese: ワールドカップの{決勝戦|けっしょうせん}をテレビで{観|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the World Cup final on TV.

notes:
{決勝戦|けっしょうせん} is used for the final match in any competitive tournament.

FORMS:
- {決勝|けっしょう} (deciding victory) + {戦|せん} (match, game)

TOURNAMENT STAGES:
- {予選|よせん}: preliminary round, qualifiers
- {一回戦|いっかいせん}: first round
- {準々決勝|じゅんじゅんけっしょう}: quarterfinals
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}: semifinals
- {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}: finals

RELATED WORDS:
- {優勝|ゆうしょう}: championship, winning
- {決勝|けっしょう}: finals (without {戦|せん})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}に{進|すす}む: to advance to the finals
- {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}を{戦|たたか}う: to compete in the finals
